View.Label: mode: 'all' vs 'class'
`'all'` parses entire XML (needed for Ti Element styling). `'class'` only scans class/ID attributes.
options.missing
Set to `true` to list missing or misspelled classes at the end of `app.tss` — great for catching typos.
options.safelist
Array of classes to keep even if not found in XML. Useful for dynamically-generated classes.

View.Label: `app.tss` is AUTO-GENERATED
Never edit `app.tss` directly — it regenerates on every build. Use `_app.tss` for custom styles or define them in `config.cjs`.
`mode: 'all'` for Ti Elements
Required if you style Ti Elements (`Label`, `Window`, etc.) in `config.cjs`.
Check 'Unused Classes' in `app.tss`
At the bottom of generated `app.tss` — lists missing or misspelled classes.
